message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crimes. Facts: Defendant bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from another person, then used a false contract to induce victim to invest 5 million RMB, promising profit from resale. He signed an agreement (contract) with victim, misrepresenting that he would purchase artifacts and sell for profit. This is fraud via contract => "合同诈骗". Also dealing in prohibited cultural relics: illegal trade of cultural relics is a crime under the Criminal Law (illegal trafficking of cultural relics). The public prosecutor mentions "××和诈骗罪". Likely they intend "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trafficking of cultural relics) and "诈骗罪". But correction rule: If facts describe use of false contract to obtain money, classify as “合同诈骗” rather than generic “诈骗”. So we should list "合同诈骗" and also the cultural relic crime. The specific offense name: "非法买卖文物罪"? The statutory name is "非法买卖文物罪" (selling prohibited cultural relics). The rule says list only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we list "合同诈骗;非法买卖文物". Ensure no "罪". Output format: [罪名]合同诈骗;非法买卖文物<eoa>. JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
